must_preserve: The vulnerability of asking whether one's quietness, overwhelm, or need for reassurance makes them hard to love.
Aachu/Zuv specificity through behavior, not generic reassurance.
The creator's rule: do not force both Aachu and Zuv into every slide.
must_not_change: Do not turn the premise into a sad portrait quote-card.
Do not copy the dark/magenta/orange concept style.
Do not make Aachu the problem or Zuv a flawless rescuer.
premise_lock.rejected_generic_version: A pretty sad girl asks 'am I hard to love?' and the boy hugs her or says no.

candidates.title: The Chair Outside The Door
candidates.one_line_concept: Aachu goes quiet behind a closed door and worries that silence makes her hard to love; Zuv proves he understands by staying near without forcing the explanation.
candidates.emotional_truth: Some people are not asking to be decoded immediately. They are asking not to be abandoned while they become speakable again.
candidates.relatable_trigger: The person who shuts down after being overwhelmed, then feels guilty because even needing space feels like a burden.
suggested_slide_arc: Closed door, chair outside, and the question: am i hard to love when i go quiet?
Water and charger appear on the chair; Zuv's hand leaves frame instead of knocking.
The chair shifts position over time, showing he is nearby but not crowding her.
The door cracks open; the water is half empty and the charger is in use.
Morning: the folded cloth is pulled inside while Zuv is asleep in the chair.
candidates.suggested_slide_1_moment: A quiet off-white hallway with a closed door, a strip of light underneath, and an empty chair outside it.
candidates.suggested_payoff_moment: Aachu's hand reaches through the cracked door for the cloth while Zuv is partly visible asleep in the chair.
candidates.visual_evidence: Door, chair, glass of water, charger, folded cloth, changed object positions, morning light.
candidates.share_or_comment_trigger: For anyone who disappears when overwhelmed but still wants to be found gently.
candidates.why_not_generic: The answer is not a line of reassurance; it is restraint made visible through objects.
failure_risks: Could become a solemn hallway mood piece if object continuity is weak.
Could make Zuv saintly if the chair becomes martyr staging.

scene_landing_preview_seed.first_frame_visual: Closed door, empty chair, light under the door, large clean upper-middle space for handwritten text.
scene_landing_preview_seed.hook_text_direction: am i hard to love when i go quiet?
mini_arc: The distance is adjusted, not erased.
The door opens enough for the care to be used.
Morning shows he stayed, but quietly.
scene_landing_preview_seed.payoff_frame: Half-empty glass and cloth pulled inside; Zuv not hero-framed.
scene_landing_preview_seed.send_or_comment_trigger: Send this as a thank-you to the person who knows when not to knock.
scene_landing_preview_seed.flat_or_generic_risk: Sad door plus text with no lived-in object changes.

candidates.risk_of_being_generic: Medium only if stripped of the chair/water/charger/folded-cloth evidence.

candidates.title: The Bag That Knew Already
candidates.one_line_concept: Aachu worries she is hard to handle, but Zuv's bag quietly shows he has learned the care instructions before the day even begins.
candidates.emotional_truth: Being loved by someone observant can make your needs feel less like a performance and more like part of the route.
candidates.relatable_trigger: The partner who knows snacks first, questions later; charger before panic; scarf before cold; exit plan before overwhelm.
suggested_slide_arc: Open bag with water, snack, charger, scarf and the question.
Aachu alone at the edge of a noisy place.
One bag object appears in use without ceremony.
Zuv's hand opens the bag again or makes room near a quieter edge.
Quiet corner: the used bag sits between them.
candidates.suggested_slide_1_moment: A lived-in open bag as a flat-lay, not a face.
candidates.suggested_payoff_moment: Aachu calmer with one item from the bag while the bag remains open and ordinary.
candidates.visual_evidence: Sling bag, water, snack, charger, scarf, softer edge of a public place.
candidates.share_or_comment_trigger: People can comment their own care instructions.
candidates.why_not_generic: It makes 'hard to handle' practical and slightly funny, not tragic.
failure_risks: Too many objects can clutter the square.
Public crowd must stay suggested, not detailed.

scene_landing_preview_seed.first_frame_visual: Open sling bag on off-white paper with four to six readable care objects.
scene_landing_preview_seed.hook_text_direction: am i hard to handle, or do i come with instructions?
mini_arc: Aachu needs one thing in public.
The bag sits open and used.
scene_landing_preview_seed.payoff_frame: The bag as evidence that her needs were expected.
scene_landing_preview_seed.flat_or_generic_risk: Aesthetic object list with no couple behavior.

candidates.risk_of_being_generic: Medium if objects are too polished or universal.

candidates.title: The Last Bite She Hid Under A Bowl
candidates.one_line_concept: Aachu asks if she is not enough while the table quietly proves she kept loving in one tiny habit: saving Zuv the best bite.
candidates.emotional_truth: People who feel hard to love often keep loving in invisible ways while apologizing for needing anything back.
candidates.relatable_trigger: Couples where the best bite silently belongs to the other person.
suggested_slide_arc: A plate with the best bite set aside and the question.
Aachu covers it with a small bowl before leaving the table.
The empty saucer later sits near her cup.
A small note-free acknowledgment, not a repayment.
candidates.suggested_slide_1_moment: Tabletop frame: plate, saved bite, Aachu's hand, clean text space.
candidates.suggested_payoff_moment: The empty saucer near Aachu's cup shows he noticed.
candidates.visual_evidence: Saved bite, bowl, saucer, cup, hand.
candidates.share_or_comment_trigger: For couples with the last-bite ritual.
candidates.why_not_generic: The insecurity is contradicted by a tiny specific act already in frame.
failure_risks: Can imply Aachu proves worth through giving.
Can become still-life quote-card if no hand/gesture appears.
Less direct fit for hard-to-love than the door/chair idea.

scene_landing_preview_seed.first_frame_visual: One plate with the best bite saved, Aachu's hand nearby.
mini_arc: She hides it under a bowl.
scene_landing_preview_seed.send_or_comment_trigger: Tag the person you save the best bite for.

candidates.risk_of_being_generic: Medium-high if it becomes proof-of-worth through selflessness.
